entries.prompt: Studio product photography contact sheet, a grid of separate panels divided by thin pure-white gutters. Every panel shares one identical setup: seamless matte white cyclorama background, a very slightly cool clinical white, no seam between floor and wall, no horizon line. One large softbox key at 40 degrees camera-left and 25 degrees above, a white bounce card camera-right for fill, neutral 5600K daylight, no coloured light, clean even pharmacy lighting. 100mm macro lens at f/9, camera at label height, straight on, no tilt. In every panel the subject is centred and upright, fills about 70 percent of the panel height, with clear white space above and below, and carries exactly one soft feathered contact shadow directly beneath it, no cast side shadow, no reflection, matte floor. Sharp focus front to back, texture of matte plastic, glass and paper clearly visible, no gloss highlights blown out.  A matte mint-green cylindrical supplement bottle about 12 cm tall with a smooth white screw cap and a plain unprinted white label band around its middle, standing upright, with three pale sand-coloured oval capsules resting on the surface beside it. Do not show: any logo, brand mark or wordmark; any legible text, letters, numbers or supplement-facts panel; health claims, seals, badges or award marks; human faces, hands or bodies; pills arranged as a face, heart or pictogram; fruit, leaves, flowers, mortar and pestle or any wellness-stock prop; coloured or gradient backgrounds, coloured gels, neon or rim-light flare; wet, glossy or mirrored floor, reflections, a second shadow, a floating subject; top-down flat lay, dutch angle or tilted horizon; shallow depth of field, bokeh or motion blur; HDR, oversaturation, heavy vignette or upscaling artefacts.
